class.name: IfcRelDeclares
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelDeclares handles the declaration of objects (subtypes of IfcObject ) or properties (subtypes of IfcPropertyDefinition ) to a project or project library (represented by IfcProject , or IfcProjectLibrary ). The relationship handles the assignment of other objects, like IfcActor , or IfcTypeObject to the project, or project libary. The attribute RelatedDefinitions p
